messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Rockstar Selection Team,

Your Dubai-based executive-search work across Director, Partner and executive mandates in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC where institutional relationships, regulatory discipline, responsible development and cross-functional execution are central to performance. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
